limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, numerical-analysis, graph-processing, hardware, performance, or operational review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on algebra, numeric type, dimensions, sparsity, graph semantics, layout, partition, hierarchy, capacity, associativity, translation, processor topology, ownership, scheduling, synchronization, compiler, toolchain, system, and workload assumptions.
